title: Golden.Meridian.S02E03.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: A PAR2-protected payload beside a 32 KiB text sidecar, five of whose eight blocks are destroyed against three recovery blocks. Every payload block verifies, so the only short file in the set is one whose extension marks it as furniture: the payload is delivered whole, no repair is attempted for a file the parity cannot rebuild, and the short sidecar makes the job a partial delivery.
